source: teacher replay of stored entering states, bf16, both CFG branches in one batch
scope: per prompt x layer x step x branch x head: the cell's pair shares (every query x every key, full 128-dim post-RoPE logits, frozen teacher) summed over the set's pairs in that cell (union of its Q and K masks). 'all' is the distribution over every entry; by_layer / by_step / by_branch over the entries of one layer, step or branch. No mean over cells. Study exemptions are not applied.
